comment: Layout contract for the backdrop template (tools/backdrop-template.html) and normalizer (tools/normalize_backdrop.py). Strips tile horizontally in-game; sky above each silhouette must stay magenta in styled sheets (keyed to transparency). Sizes are native pixels.

strips.name: far
strips.what: La Cloche mountains, white quartzite ridges, lakes at their feet (lakes in the y 95-130 band — revealed when the player climbs)

strips.name: mid
strips.what: dense conifer forest silhouette, solid below its treeline
